# Feature 1: comment editing

Endpoint: PUT /api/articles/:slug/comments/:id with body {"comment":{"body":"..."}}. Only the comment author may edit, within the edit window. Each successful edit sets the edited marker.

## Rules relied on (values are not copied here; read them from the source)

- Who may edit, and the edit window: policy-edit-window
- Author identity field: code-comment-ownership (authorId)
- Comment timestamps used by the window: code-comment-model (createdAt)
- Edited marker, its default, and migration rule for existing rows: policy-edited-at-marker
- Current Comment fields: code-comment-model
- Migration folders, naming, apply command, database address: code-migrations
- Release steps and per-migration undo note: policy-release-checklist
- Error body shape for new responses: policy-error-response
- Status code for validation errors: code-error-shape
- Auth token parsing: code-auth-header
- Unit test location and run command: code-test-layout

## Conflicts

- Error body: code-error-shape shows the existing 401 body with a status and message key. policy-error-response says new responses use the errors-key shape. Followed policy-error-response for new responses. The existing 401 body is not changed by this feature.

## Rules not found (do not invent; ask before choosing)

- Status code when an edit is refused after the window closes.
- Status code when a non-author tries to edit.
- Whether a soft-deleted comment may be edited. policy-soft-delete mentions deletedAt, but code-comment-model has no such field.

content.text:
The comment edit endpoint, the migration and the unit tests are written, but the feature is not ready to ship. Three refusal cases have no status code in the rule notes, so they currently fall through to a 500. I did not run Prisma, the migration or the tests, because I cannot run them in this session.

**Open: status codes the notes do not give.** Your spec lists these as unanswered, and I did not invent values:
- Comment not found (or the slug does not match the comment's article).
- Non-author edit.
- Edit after the 15 minute window.

In `app/src/app/routes/article/article.service.ts` these throw plain `Error`s with `OPEN:` comments. Until someone picks codes, the API returns 500 with the message as the body. Replace each with an `HttpException` once the codes are decided. The unit tests check the messages, so they will need a small update then.

**Files changed**
- `app/src/prisma/schema.prisma`: adds `editedAt DateTime?` to `Comment`.
- `app/src/prisma/migrations/20261030120000_comment_edited_at/migration.sql`: adds the nullable column, which leaves existing rows unchanged, plus a one-line undo note.
- `app/src/app/routes/article/article.service.ts`: adds `editComment`.
- `app/src/app/routes/article/article.controller.ts`: adds `PUT /articles/:slug/comments/:id`, behind `auth.required`.
- `app/src/tests/services/article.service.edit-comment.test.ts`: six Jest tests.

**Rules applied, value, and source**
- Edit window: 15 minutes after `createdAt`. Source: `policy-edit-window`.
- Author check: `authorId` must equal the current user id. Source: `code-comment-ownership`.
- Edited marker: nullable `editedAt`, null until the first edit, set to the edit time on each successful edit. Migration must not change existing rows. Source: `policy-edited-at-marker`.
- Migration folder: under `app/src/prisma/migrations`, named with a timestamp, one folder per migration. Source: `code-migrations`.
- Undo note: one line per migration. Source: `policy-release-checklist`.
- Error body: `{"errors":{"body":["can't be blank"]}}` with no wrapper. Source: `policy-error-response`.
- Blank body status: 422. Source: `code-error-shape`.
- Auth token: read by the existing `auth.required` middleware, which takes `Token` or `Bearer`. Source: `code-auth-header`.
- Test location and command: `app/src/tests/services`, `*.test.ts`, run with `npx nx test api`. The database is mocked with `prisma-mock.ts`. Source: `code-test-layout`.

**Conflicts**
- Error body: `code-error-shape` shows the 401 body with `status` and `message`, and `policy-error-response` says new responses use the `errors` key. I followed `policy-error-response` for the new 422. The existing 401 is unchanged.
- Soft delete: `policy-soft-delete` mentions `deletedAt`, but the schema has no such field and `code-comment-model` says there is none. I did not add it, and I did not decide whether a deleted comment can be edited.

**Choices I made that you may want changed**
- The 15 minute boundary is inclusive: an edit at exactly 15 minutes is allowed.
- The lookup also matches the slug through the comment's article, so a comment cannot be edited under the wrong article.
- The response includes `editedAt`, and `updatedAt` is not changed by the edit.
- The controller reads `req.body.comment?.body`, so a missing `comment` key gives the 422 rather than a crash.

**Not done**
- `npx prisma generate` is needed before TypeScript knows `editedAt`, and the tests will fail type checks until it runs.
- `npx prisma migrate deploy` against a fresh database, required by the release checklist, has not been run.
- The tests have not been run.
